original_test_intent: Safely extend the designated lab InfiniBand fabric through UFM's phased NDT merger and prove the intended topology deploys with unique GUIDs and healthy boundary links.
original_method: Pin and validate initial/combined NDT hashes against approved current/new topology; snapshot UFM/fabric/jobs/routes; maintenance isolate; deploy initial file; operator connects exact equipment; map/open only approved boundary ports to No-discover; redeploy active file; validate no duplicate GUIDs; deploy combined NDT; verify topology/routes/errors and retain rollback files.
manual_activity: Fabric owner approves NDT/topology/window; operator connects equipment and confirms ports; UFM owner controls deploy/rollback.
required_inputs: Initial/combined NDT hashes and topology oracle
safety_requirements: Stop on validation/routing/link/job anomaly; no auto-retry
